title: Verkada connector (Beta)
body:
The Verkada connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

The connector ingests organization audit logs and access users from your Verkada organization into Databricks. Authentication uses a Verkada organization API key.

See [Verkada connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/verkada).
